summary: Repaired the progress diagnostic exposed by the actual automatic-repair scenario and narrowed it to resolved discrepancies, so new error records cannot falsely count as progress.
findings: The controller passed Python tuples into canonical JSON hashing, which correctly rejected them.
The same diagnostic would have counted newly raised issues as progress; the intended criterion is an existing uncertainty actually resolved.
changes: Compare sets of resolved issue identities directly, and reset no-progress only for a newly resolved issue.
regression: Execute the scripted omission repair end to end and require preserved blind candidates, resolved structural omission and a still-blocked Java/meaning outcome.
Rerun all P1 and P2 cases including last-slot race, crash recovery and stale fences.
